findings.title: Team admin/owner check uses AND instead of OR
findings.body: File packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/addGuests.handler.ts line 46 computes isTeamAdminOrOwner as (await isTeamAdmin(...)) && (await isTeamOwner(...)). This requires the caller to be both admin and owner at once, so a user who is only an admin or only an owner fails the check. Consequence: legitimate team admins/owners get FORBIDDEN and cannot add guests; the intent was clearly OR.

findings.title: Duplicate emails inside request create duplicate attendees
findings.body: File packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/addGuests.handler.ts line 74 filters guests only against existing booking.attendees, and packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/addGuests.schema.ts does not enforce uniqueness. If guests is [a@x.com, a@x.com] neither matches an existing attendee, so both pass the filter and createMany inserts two Attendee rows with the same email. Consequence: duplicate attendee records, duplicate emails/calendar invites, broken attendee lists. Client-side uniqueness in AddGuestsDialog can be bypassed by direct API calls.

findings.title: Email routing uses raw input instead of filtered guests
findings.body: File packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/addGuests.handler.ts line 168 calls sendAddGuestsEmails(evt, guests) with the original input instead of uniqueGuests. Guests that were already attendees or blacklisted and therefore not inserted are still treated as newGuests in packages/emails/email-manager.ts newGuests.includes(...), so existing attendees incorrectly receive the new-guest AttendeeScheduledEmail instead of AttendeeAddGuestsEmail, and filtered addresses affect classification. Consequence: wrong email content sent to existing attendees.

findings.title: Blacklist check is case-sensitive and bypassable
findings.body: File packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/addGuests.handler.ts line 70 lowercases BLACKLISTED_GUEST_EMAILS but line 77 compares raw guest without lowercasing or trimming, and line 76 compares guest === attendee.email exactly. Consequence: Guest@blocked.com bypasses a blacklist entry for guest@blocked.com, and Foo@Bar.com duplicates foo@bar.com, defeating the blocklist and duplicate suppression.

findings.title: DB write commits before calendar update with no rollback
findings.body: File packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/addGuests.handler.ts line 92 prisma.booking.update inserts new attendees, then line 165 eventManager.updateCalendarAttendees updates external calendars. If the calendar update throws, the DB rows remain while calendars are stale, with no transaction or compensation. Consequence: database and Google/Outlook calendars diverge; retrying adds confusion and there is no cleanup path.

findings.title: Calendar update uses requester credentials instead of organizer
findings.body: File packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/addGuests.handler.ts line 158 loads getUsersCredentials(ctx.user) and builds EventManager from the requesting user, even though the booking query already fetched booking.user.credentials (the organizer). If a team admin or attendee adds guests, the update runs against the requester's calendars, not the organizer's. Consequence: calendar attendee update fails or mutates the wrong calendar, so added guests never appear on the real event.

findings.title: Add-guests emails ignore standard-email disable flags
findings.body: File packages/emails/email-manager.ts line 525 sendAddGuestsEmails never checks eventTypeDisableHostEmail/eventTypeDisableAttendeeEmail or host/attendee disabled flags, unlike sendScheduledEmails, sendRescheduledEmails, sendLocationChangeEmails. Consequence: users/event types that disabled standard emails still get organizer/attendee add-guests emails, violating user preference and spamming attendees.

findings.title: Invalid-email error state never cleared on retry/success
findings.body: File apps/web/components/dialog/AddGuestsDialog.tsx sets isInvalidEmail true on failed validation but neither handleAdd on success nor onSuccess resets it to false (only cancel does). Consequence: after fixing emails and submitting, the Errors must be unique and valid banner stays visible during/after a successful add and on next open, confusing users.

findings.title: List items keyed by index cause wrong row after delete
findings.body: File packages/ui/form/MultiEmail.tsx line 26 uses key={index} for controlled EmailField rows while deletion splices the array. Consequence: React reuses DOM nodes by position, so removing a middle email can show the wrong value in the wrong row, lose focus, or preserve stale validation state.

findings.title: Add-guests offered for past/cancelled bookings
findings.body: File apps/web/components/booking/BookingListItem.tsx line 193 adds the additional_guests edit action unconditionally, and bookedActions including edit_booking are still rendered for past confirmed bookings. Consequence: users can open AddGuestsDialog and insert attendees on ended or cancelled events, producing meaningless DB rows, calendar writes, and emails for events that already happened.
